name: pact-contract-testing
description: PACT contract testing for TMS API

scripts.test: npm run test:consumer && npm run test:provider
scripts.pact:publish: pact-broker publish ./pacts --broker-base-url=${PACT_BROKER_URL:-http://localhost:9292} --consumer-app-version=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD) --branch=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD)
scripts.can-i-deploy:consumer: pact-broker can-i-deploy --pacticipant CargoPlanConsole --version=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD) --to-environment production --broker-base-url=${PACT_BROKER_URL:-http://localhost:9292}
scripts.can-i-deploy:provider: pact-broker can-i-deploy --pacticipant TmsApi --version=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD) --to-environment production --broker-base-url=${PACT_BROKER_URL:-http://localhost:9292}
scripts.record-deployment:consumer: pact-broker record-deployment --pacticipant CargoPlanConsole --version=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD) --environment production --broker-base-url=${PACT_BROKER_URL:-http://localhost:9292}
scripts.record-deployment:provider: pact-broker record-deployment --pacticipant TmsApi --version=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD) --environment production --broker-base-url=${PACT_BROKER_URL:-http://localhost:9292}
